sources.claim: Elon Musk was born on 28 June 1971 in Pretoria, South Africa.
sources.caution: 기본 인물 정보.

sources.claim: At age 12, Musk sold code for the game Blastar for about $500.
sources.caution: 당시 원계약서가 아니라 전기·프로필 보도에 기반.

sources.claim: Musk has served as Tesla CEO since October 2008 and joined the board in April 2004.
sources.caution: Tesla 자체 공시성 약력.

sources.claim: SpaceX incorporated in 2002; Falcon 1 reached orbit in September 2008; NASA awarded a $1.6B CRS contract in December 2008.
sources.caution: NASA press kit milestone table.

sources.claim: The 2018 SEC settlement required Musk to leave the Tesla chair for three years and Musk/Tesla to each pay $20M.
sources.caution: 합의는 위법 사실을 인정하거나 부인하지 않는 형태.

sources.claim: Twitter’s merger closed on 27 October 2022 at $54.20 per share.
sources.caution: 통상 약 440억달러 거래로 표현되나 최종 자금 구조는 별도.

sources.claim: Musk carried a kitchen sink into Twitter headquarters before closing the acquisition.
sources.caution: 공개 영상과 Reuters 보도로 확인.

sources.claim: Neuralink announced its first human implant in January 2024.
sources.caution: 회사 발표이며 임상 효능 전반을 의미하지 않음.

sources.claim: OpenAI launched in 2015 with Sam Altman and Elon Musk as co-chairs and a stated $1B commitment from backers.
sources.caution: 약정액과 실제 납입액은 구분.

sources.claim: OpenAI says Musk proposed a for-profit structure with control and later a Tesla combination.
sources.caution: OpenAI가 소송 대응 과정에서 선별 공개한 자료. 중립적 판정이 아님.

sources.claim: Musk filed his first state-court suit on 29 February 2024, withdrew it in June, and refiled federally in August 2024.
sources.caution: 취하·재제기는 별도 Reuters 기사와 교차 확인.

sources.claim: The court denied Musk’s preliminary injunction in March 2025 while moving toward an expedited trial.
sources.caution: 가처분 기각은 최종 본안 판단과 다름.

sources.claim: A Musk-led group offered $97.4B for the OpenAI nonprofit; Altman publicly joked about buying Twitter for $9.74B.
sources.caution: 인수 제안은 이사회가 거절했으며 거래가 성사된 가격이 아님.

sources.claim: OpenAI countersued Musk in April 2025, alleging harassment and competitive interference.
sources.caution: 맞소송의 주장이지 확정 사실이 아님.

sources.claim: In May 2025 OpenAI revised restructuring plans to retain nonprofit control.
sources.caution: 세부 지분·법인 구조는 이후에도 변할 수 있음.

sources.claim: Musk dropped fraud claims before the April 2026 trial, leaving charitable-trust and unjust-enrichment theories.
sources.caution: 재판 직전 절차상 범위.

sources.claim: On 18 May 2026 a unanimous jury found Musk’s claims time-barred after less than two hours; the judge accepted the advisory verdict.
sources.caution: 시효 판단이며 OpenAI 사명 논쟁의 실체까지 판정한 것은 아님.

sources.claim: Musk said he would appeal; no final appellate ruling was identified by 9 August 2026.
sources.caution: 항소 절차는 변동 가능. 최종 appellate result가 없다는 제한적 표현만 사용.

sources.claim: Musk was ousted as PayPal CEO while away on a honeymoon.
sources.caution: 회사 기록이 아니라 복수 전기·보도에서 반복되는 일화.

sources.claim: Musk crashed an uninsured McLaren F1 with Peter Thiel as passenger and was not seriously hurt.
sources.caution: 전기적 일화로 분류.

sources.claim: Early Zip2 colleagues recalled Musk sleeping at the office and showering at a YMCA.
sources.caution: 직원·가족 회고 기반.

sources.claim: A Russian negotiator allegedly spat on Musk’s shoes during failed rocket talks.
sources.caution: Lori Garver 회고록의 서술로 독립적인 1차 확인이 제한됨.

sources.claim: 캐나다 이주와 Queen’s 재학 시기.
